judgment: BOTH FAIL. Six variants now tested (tanh removal, batch composition, log-scale init, norm removal fixed-scale, norm removal + big learned scale, norm removal + small learned scale): collapse-or-freeze in all six. The attractor is not any single knob; the learning arms (pretrained-init, cross) win by STARTING with representation diversity an architecture can amplify, not by a tunable scalar. Dual-random from-scratch on this budget is a documented dead end, not a fixable configuration.
mechanism_refinement: Fix A shows the failure mode is logit-magnitude, not tanh/norm per se: unnormalized dots x scale 14.3 -> s0 logits ~90 -> one-hot-on-noise -> same uniform fixed point. Fix B shows small logits + no norm -> variation decays without learning signal. Learnable corridor (logits O(1) WITH variation) is never entered from random init under any tested geometry.
product_consequence: Dual path is supported ONLY with pretrained init (empirically learns: 0.33-0.46). No from-scratch dual offering.
